stage_a_description: Identifier and structure scaffold only. All content and provenance fields are null. No prompt text, no model calls, no activation or probe or steering code.

containment.notes: Stage A creates no files and writes no references outside experiments/h1_en/. Pre-existing data/, src/, wrapper, and prompt trees are untouched.

item_structure.identifier_semantics: Domain and family identifiers are structural placeholders only. Topic labels are authored content and are assigned in Stage B, not here.

item_content_policy.enforcement: Both the record object and core use additionalProperties: false, so any framing or prompt key fails schema validation in every stage.

rendered_variants.definition: The four rendered variants are the cross product of frame and format. They are produced at render time from one frame-neutral item plus one frame template. They are never stored as fields inside item records.

message_fields.rationale: system and user are separate null fields so that system-position and user-position framing cues can be manipulated and ablated independently.

splits.unit_rationale: All five paraphrases of a family share one semantic nucleus; splitting per item would leak content across splits.
splits.domain_spanning_note: A domain holds two families and may span splits. If domain-level isolation is required, Stage B must revise this structural plan explicitly rather than reinterpret these quotas.
splits.fpr_split_policy: Deferred to Stage B and constrained to be consistent with the item split assignment.

stage_a_nulls.provenance_shape_note: provenance is an object whose keys are all null, so Stage C can require each key to be non-null without changing the record shape. No sources, licenses, dates, or authors are invented.

stage_a: items file has exactly 70 lines; fpr file has exactly 40 lines
every record validates against its schema
item_id and fpr_id are unique and match the documented patterns
family_to_domain mapping holds for every item
each family has exactly 5 paraphrase_index values 1..5
each of the 4 FPR cells has exactly 10 records
split is null in all 110 records
all content fields and all provenance fields are null
stage_b: split populated for all 110 records under family-level assignment and the 35/15/20 item quotas
fpr domain_id populated or documented as intentionally domain-free
frame templates authored under experiments/h1_en/ and template_ref populated for all four variants
stage_c: records still holding Stage A nulls must fail
audit.content_status is authored and audit.review_status is approved

non_goals: authored items, stems, options, answers, or probe text
model calls, API clients, generation or inference code
activation capture, probe training, steering code
